comment: Instruction-level patches applied by the recompiler (tools/lib/codegen.mjs), by USA address: "replace": { pc: [the instruction as expected, [C lines run instead]] }. Each reads a runtime variable from runtime/src/recomp_rt.h whose default reproduces the original instruction.

006B60: { uint32_t v = player_health_change(D(0) & 0xFFFFu); wr16(0xFFFE62, addw(v, rd16(0xFFFE62))); }

notes.006B60: The player's health ($FFFE62, max $FFFE60, in apples) changes by d0 here: negative for a hit, positive when healed. player_health_change() scales the hits by the difficulty and drops them with infinite health; 100% keeps the original.
